title: India Develops Indigenous Battle Rifle in Record Time
summary: The Indian government has developed an indigenous battle rifle, the UGRAM, in just 100 days. The rifle has cleared key trials and is set to be procured by the CAPF. This development marks a significant achievement for India's defense sector.
summary_points: India has developed an indigenous battle rifle called UGRAM
The UGRAM was developed in record time, taking just 100 days
The rifle has cleared key trials and is set to be procured by the CAPF
This development marks a significant achievement for India's defense sector
